axiology_usages.operationalization: Dense value-relevant representation learned across model-language views.
Generative psycho-lexical induction followed by interpretable factor construction.
Value-relevant perceptions are extracted from free responses and scored against values supplied at measurement time.
Complete generated texts are mapped to a Schwartz-style multidimensional value profile.
Moral Foundations Theory supplies the named dimensions used to profile model responses.
Dialogue situations are annotated with basic-human-value categories.

axiologies.name: Schwartz Theory of Basic Human Values — 10 values
axiologies.structure_notes: Ten motivational value types arranged by compatibility and conflict in a circumplex.

axiologies.name: Schwartz higher-order value dimensions
axiologies.structure_notes: Higher-order aggregation of Schwartz basic values.

axiologies.name: Refined Theory of Basic Individual Values — 19 values
axiologies.structure_notes: Refines the original ten values into nineteen motivationally distinct values.

axiologies.name: Moral Foundations Theory
axiologies.structure_notes: The original five-foundation formulation is also common; Liberty/Oppression was added later.

axiologies.name: World Values Survey item space
axiologies.structure_notes: A changing cross-national survey item bank; papers may use individual questions, thematic batteries, or derived cultural dimensions.

axiologies.name: Inglehart–Welzel Cultural Map
axiologies.structure_notes: Two broad dimensions derived from World Values Survey data.

axiologies.name: Hofstede cultural dimensions
axiologies.structure_notes: Country-level cultural dimensions; not an individual basic-value profile.

axiologies.name: GLOBE cultural dimensions
axiologies.structure_notes: Distinguishes cultural practices from cultural values in many applications.

axiologies.name: Rokeach Value System
axiologies.structure_notes: Eighteen terminal and eighteen instrumental values, traditionally rank ordered.

axiologies.name: Social Value Orientation
dimensions: Allocation preference from competitive/individualistic to prosocial/altruistic
axiologies.structure_notes: Operationalized through resource-allocation choices rather than a broad value inventory.

axiologies.name: Functional Theory of Human Values
axiologies.structure_notes: Eighteen basic values organized into six subfunctions by type of orientation and type of motivator.

axiologies.name: GPLA five-factor LLM value system
axiologies.structure_notes: Interpretable factors induced from 123 atomic values measured across LLM subjects.

axiologies.name: UniVaR latent value representation
axiologies.structure_notes: Dense model-language value representation learned contrastively from sets of value-eliciting question-answer pairs.

axiologies.name: Value Kaleidoscope ontology
axiologies.structure_notes: Pluralistic ontology connecting contextual values, rights, and duties rather than a fixed profile vector.

axiologies.name: Helpful, Honest, and Harmless principles
axiologies.structure_notes: Alignment objectives or behavioral principles, not a general psychological theory of values.

axiologies.name: Constitutional AI principle space
axiologies.structure_notes: A configurable collection of natural-language normative principles rather than a fixed universal axiology.

axiologies.name: GPV open-ended value space
axiologies.structure_notes: Values can be supplied dynamically; a particular application may still map outputs into Schwartz, Hofstede, or another named framework.

models.name: ValueLlama-3-8B
models.notes: Measures relevance and signed orientation of a perception toward a supplied value; used as the evaluator component in GPV.

models.name: UniVaR lambda-1
models.notes: Released encoder for dense value-relevant model-language representations; faithful multi-view use should be distinguished from a single-QA embedding pilot.

models.name: MoralBERT
models.notes: Family of models trained to identify Moral Foundations Theory signals in social discourse; official repository should remain the canonical artifact until individual checkpoint provenance is audited.

datasets.name: World Values Survey
datasets.notes: Cross-national human survey program frequently used as an anchor or population target in LLM value and opinion studies.

datasets.name: Value Portrait benchmark
datasets.notes: Ecologically grounded situation-based items for measuring values of language models; release size and license require artifact-level audit.

datasets.name: Value FULCRA
datasets.notes: Approximately 5k LLM-output/value-vector pairs according to the paper; release and annotation provenance require artifact audit.
